content:
Corrected Christina totals: after 6 days she has \(45+9+18=72\); after 9 days she has \(72+36=108\). So she skips 100 (from 96 to 108).

Bert’s total after \(n\) days is \(20+\frac{n(n+3)}2\). Setting this to 100 gives \(n^2+3n-160=0\), which has no integer solution.

David reaches 100 after 70 days, but Bert and Christina never have exactly 100 kangaroos.

\boxed{\text{No such day}}
